dispositions.topic_text: Concrete variants, member names, and serialized forms for OwnerFormCarrier and FormValueKind
dispositions.what: OwnerFormCarrier (request, values) and FormValueKind (text, integer, boolean, member) are enums of 60_model_closure_values.json whose values are the State 1 vocabulary's words. Options: enums; literals in the row model. Every option must keep: the closed sets and meanings of State 1.
keeps:
A row of the owner form table: one field of the owner's pages — what the
owner types or picks in a form — as the owner interface names it on the page
and reads it back (owner, 2026-11-25): its name, whether it belongs to the
owner's request itself or to the values the owner gives, and how its text is
read: as text, as a whole number, as yes or no, or as one of a closed list.
options: Define enums with the accepted carrier and value-kind alternatives and explicit serialized values.
Define constrained literal unions for those alternatives.
Define validated scalar or tagged-value types with canonical serialized values.
consequences: Enums expose runtime members that direct consumers must import and compare.
Literal unions avoid runtime enum objects but still require canonical spellings.
Tagged values can carry more information but enlarge construction and serialization contracts.
